name: cc-react
description: React-style UI framework for CC: Tweaked + Tom's Peripherals GPU. Compiles .tsx to a Lua module whose start(side) runs as a simpleParallel task.

scripts.test: luac5.1 -p dist/ui.lua && luac5.1 -p dist/fixture-multi.lua && luac5.1 -p dist/fixture-scroll.lua && luac5.1 -p dist/fixture-input.lua && luac5.1 -p dist/fixture-network.lua && lua5.1 scripts/test_main.lua dist/ui.lua && lua5.1 scripts/test_multiimport.lua dist/fixture-multi.lua && lua5.1 scripts/test_scroll.lua dist/fixture-scroll.lua && lua5.1 scripts/test_input.lua dist/fixture-input.lua && lua5.1 scripts/test_network.lua dist/fixture-network.lua
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run build:fixture && npm run build:fixture:scroll && npm run build:fixture:input && npm run build:fixture:network && npm run test
